page.title: Management
page.subtitle: Manage Popov Agent: service library, observability stacks, LLM credentials, knowledge (system grounding), and memory. Monitoring & notifications per workspace are managed in each workspace's Settings page.

memory.description: Popov's episodic memory (Second Brain) — delete wrong episodes so they stop being used.
memory.empty: No episodes (filter or memory is still empty)
memory.delete_description: This episodic memory will be permanently deleted — Popov Agent will no longer use it as historical context.

apikeys.title: API Keys
apikeys.description: Credentials Popov Agent uses to answer. The provider with the Active LLM badge is the one in use; keys are encrypted and never shown again. Takes effect immediately without restart.
apikeys.per_model_hint: Each provider has its own model — fill it when adding/editing. Provider with the Active LLM badge = currently used by the backend.
apikeys.empty_credentials: No credentials yet. Click "Add provider" to install an API key.
apikeys.embedding_description: Incident memory for historical context. Choose Local Only (TF cosine, no API) or provider-based AI embedding.
apikeys.not_configured: Not configured — activate embedding via an AI provider
apikeys.llm_modal_description: Fill in the provider's model, endpoint, and API key. An empty key means keep the existing one.
apikeys.key_placeholder: Paste a new key… (leave empty to keep)
apikeys.emb_modal_description: Pick the provider and embedding model for Second Brain.
apikeys.emb_max_chars_hint: Max characters to embed per document. Increase for longer docs (e.g. 8000 for Nemotron 8k ctx). Default: 8000.
apikeys.test_saved_title: Test using the saved credentials (no changes needed)

service_library.owner_only_read_error: Only the document owner can read it
service_library.owner_only_edit_error: Only the document owner can edit it
service_library.manage_knowledge_title: Manage knowledge — a library entry is created automatically if none exists
service_library.knowledge_empty: No knowledge linked to this service yet.
service_library.intro_strong: General services (cross-workspace) can be used in any project/workspace. Workspace-specific services are managed in Workspace Settings → Services (scoped). Link knowledge so Popov Agent analyzes with service context.
service_library.all_registered_suffix: All global monitoring services have already been added.
service_library.create_dialog_description: Services are free to create — think of them as your K8s deployments. They apply general/cross-workspace; workspace-specific services are managed in Workspace Settings → Services.
service_library.custom_service_hint: Custom service (not registered for global monitoring)
service_library.global_service_hint: Lowercase letters/numbers/-/_ · globally registered = full analysis; custom = still analyzable if you fill the log connection
service_library.delete_in_use_desc: ⚠️ Service is still used in {{projects}}. Deleting it unlinks the service (and its knowledge links) from all those projects — Popov will no longer use its context there.
service_library.delete_simple_desc: The service will be removed from your library.

knowledge_lib.title: Knowledge Service
knowledge_lib.description: Details how a service works: business logic, collection map, inter-service relationships, incident playbook. Owned by you — linked to workspace/service as additional context for analysis (does not affect routing).
knowledge_lib.empty_all: No knowledge yet. Create your first document.
knowledge_lib.dialog_desc: Plain markdown text (.md). Max 200KB. Name is auto-slugified.
knowledge_lib.chars_hint: Markdown (heading, list, table, code block supported) · {{count}} characters
knowledge_lib.delete_in_use: ⚠️ This document is still used in {{names}}. Deleting it will also unlink the knowledge from all those workspaces — Popov Agent will no longer use it for analysis there.
knowledge_lib.delete_plain: The document will be permanently deleted from your library.
knowledge_lib.content_too_long: Content exceeds maximum {{maxChars}} characters (current: {{actual}}). Shorten the content or increase Max Characters in Management → API Keys → Embedding.
knowledge_lib.updated: Knowledge updated — all linked workspaces get the new version
knowledge_lib.deleted_with_refs: Document deleted along with {{count}} workspace link(s)
knowledge_lib.empty_all_selection: No knowledge in your library yet. Create a new document in Management → Knowledge.
knowledge_lib.grounding_empty: No grounding docs connected. Click '+ Connect' to link system grounding docs to this workspace.
knowledge_lib.grounding_picker_desc: Select grounding docs from Management to connect to this workspace. These are read-only references — edits happen in Management.
knowledge_lib.grounding_picker_empty: All grounding docs are already connected to this workspace.

agent_docs.meta_invalid_json: Meta is not valid JSON — check commas/braces
agent_docs.title: Grounding — System
agent_docs.description: System-wide technical instructions & definitions (DevOps view): general knowledge, monitored services (registry + collections), response playbooks, inter-service architecture, data schemas, observability. Global (admin) — used by the backend for routing & RCA. Source: DB agent_docs. Edit here — applies instantly without restart via reload.
agent_docs.body_placeholder:
# Description / Runbook
Context for the LLM during RCA…
agent_docs.delete_confirm_desc: This grounding document will be permanently deleted from the DB. Popov Agent will no longer use it for RAG/RCA. Auto-reload after deletion.
agent_docs.dialog_description_services: Category Services — meta JSON + body markdown. Meta must be valid JSON.

api_key.description: Manage API keys for external integrations. Public keys have stricter rate limits and limited scopes.
api_key.select_workspace: Select a workspace to manage API keys
api_key.name: Name
api_key.type_web_hint: Full access to all endpoints (internal integrations)
api_key.key_warning: Save this key now — it will NOT be shown again.
api_key.create_description: Generate a new API key for external integrations.
api_key.created_description: Copy your new API key below. You will NOT be able to see it again.
api_key.revoke_description: This key will be immediately deactivated. This action cannot be undone.
